understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by placing each selectable piece onto a goal tile (+); when multiple goals exist, all must be occupied simultaneously for a win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel grid increments, and movement can be blocked by walls or boundaries. Adjacent pushable blocks may move when pushed, while walls generally stop movement. CLICK selects a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, allowing control to switch between pieces; repeated clicking only switches selection and consumes steps.
